data.providerPathway: New York requires the provider to be approved by the NY State Education Department for LMHC CE under 8 NYCRR 79-9.8(i); NBCC ACEP sponsorship alone is not the NYSED approval described by the rule. EduCare ACEP8109 therefore cannot be treated as qualifying on the supplied NBCC status alone.
data.asyncRule: Asynchronous self-study is expressly accepted only when offered by a NYSED-approved provider. The official NYSED provider guidance requires a post-test, a passing score before the completion certificate, and identifies the course type on the certificate.
data.limits: 36 hours per triennial registration period; no more than 12 hours (one-third in a different-length period) may be self-study. Courses must be at least one hour/contact hour (quarter hours may be used for courses longer than one hour). Provider records: at least six years.
data.passage: NYSED states: “each Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) must complete 36 hours of approved continuing education courses for each triennial registration period. No more than 12 hours ... may consist of self-study educational activities from New York State Education Department approved providers.” Its provider guidance says: “self-study courses ... offered by a Department approved provider”; “A self-study course must incorporate a post-test ... The learner must achieve a minimum passing score ... before a certificate of completion is awarded”; “All continuing education courses/activities must be a minimum of one hour”; and “Only Department approved providers may award continuing education credit hours.” (8 NYCRR 79-9.8(i)(2)-(3), (i)(3)(ii)(d)-(e)).

data.providerPathway: NYSED-approved provider for marriage and family therapy under 8 NYCRR 79-10.8(i) is the explicit pathway. NBCC ACEP8109 status by itself is not NYSED LMFT-provider approval.
data.asyncRule: Self-study is allowed when supplied by a NYSED-approved provider; the official page does not make NBCC approval a substitute for NYSED approval.
data.limits: 36 approved hours per triennial registration period; no more than 12 hours in any 36 months (or one-third for another period) may be self-study.
data.passage: NYSED states: “Beginning January 1, 2017 each Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) must complete 36 hours of approved continuing education courses for each triennial registration period. No more than 12 hours of continuing education activities in any 36 month period, or one-third of the total hours in periods of other length, may consist of self-study educational activities from New York State Education Department approved providers.” The page links provider approval under “Section 79-10.8(i) of the Regulations of the Commissioner.”

data.providerPathway: NYSED-approved provider for social-work CE under 8 NYCRR 74.10(i) is required. NBCC ACEP8109 status alone does not establish that profession-specific NYSED approval.
data.asyncRule: Self-study is accepted only from New York State Education Department approved providers; therefore an asynchronous certificate alone does not establish eligibility.
data.limits: 36 approved hours per triennial registration period; no more than 12 hours in any 36 months (or one-third for another period) may be self-study.
data.passage: NYSED states: “Beginning January 1, 2015, each Licensed Master Social Worker (LMSW) and Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) must complete 36 hours of approved continuing education courses for each triennial registration period. No more than 12 hours ... may consist of self-study educational activities from New York State Education Department approved providers.” The page identifies provider approval under “Section 74.10(i) of the Regulations of the Commissioner.”

data.providerPathway: The governing source is 21 NCAC 53 .0603, and the Board’s renewal page identifies Rule .0603 as controlling. EduCare’s NBCC ACEP8109 status must match the rule’s approved-provider pathway; NBCC sponsorship must not be substituted for approved-provider status.
data.asyncRule: The official Board renewal page expressly describes renewal CE and documentation/audit requirements, but the fetched official material did not establish that this specific EduCare asynchronous course is accepted under the rule; consequently status is conditional rather than supported.
data.limits: 40 contact hours per renewal (30 when the initial renewal period is under two full years); retain documentation for seven years; random audit. See 21 NCAC 53 .0603.
data.passage: The Board page says: “Forty (40) contact hours of continuing counselor education is required for renewal. In the case of newly issued licenses in which the initial renewal period is less than two full years, thirty (30) contact hours is required.” It also says licensees “must maintain documentation of continuing education for seven years following the date of completion” and cites “Rule .0603.”

data.providerPathway: 21 NCAC 31 .0701 requires qualifying MFT CE to be approved by the NC Marriage and Family Therapy Licensure Board; NBCC ACEP8109 is not, by itself, that Board approval.
data.asyncRule: The official CE guideline fetched does not state that asynchronous home-study with a posttest is accepted; therefore it cannot be marked supported.
data.limits: 20 hours annually/each renewal; 3 hours ethics included; up to 12 hours may be ongoing supervision with an AAMFT-approved supervisor or candidate. Completion evidence is a signed certificate containing dates, hours, name and subject matter.
data.passage: The Board guideline states: “shall submit each year with the license renewal forms evidence of 20 hours of continuing education”; “Evidence of completion shall consist of a certificate of attendance and completion signed by the continuing education provider and shall include date(s) of attendance, number of hours, name”; “Three hours of ethics training ... is required”; and ongoing supervision “may be utilized for up to 12 hours.” It also states courses dealing with MFT practice, therapeutic issues, ethics and supervision “shall be approved by the Board.”

data.providerPathway: The NC Social Work Board does not pre-approve providers generally, but distance-learning activities must carry pre-approval by ASWB-ACE or NASW-NC under 21 NCAC 63 .0401. NBCC ACEP8109 is not one of the listed pathways.
data.asyncRule: Distance learning includes “online courses” and “home study courses”; it is acceptable only if pre-approved by ASWB-ACE or NASW-NC and regulatory requirements are met. Thus an NBCC-only asynchronous course is not established as qualifying.
data.limits: 40 contact hours per two-year renewal cycle, including at least 4 ethics hours; maximum 20 hours (one-half) through distance learning. Board audit requires verifiable proof of attendance and credit hours; certificates need not be attached to the renewal affidavit.
data.passage: The Board states: “The Board does NOT have a process for pre-approving courses or providers; however, distance learning activities must carry pre-approval by ASWB or NASW-NC.” It defines distance learning as including “online courses, home study courses” and says: “A maximum of twenty hours (one-half) ... per two-year renewal cycle may be obtained through distance learning activities.” It further requires “40 contact hours ... with at least 4 hours of ethics focused training” and “verifiable proof of attendance and credit hours.”

data.providerPathway: North Dakota Board of Counselor Examiners states CE must be approved and directs acceptance questions to the Board; the fetched official material does not expressly identify NBCC Approved Continuing Education Provider status as an approval pathway. NBCC sponsorship/provider status is not treated as state approval.
data.asyncRule: The fetched official counselor CE page does not expressly address asynchronous home-study, posttests, or completion certificates; therefore an EduCare ACEP8109 asynchronous course cannot be marked supported without Board confirmation.
data.limits: LPC: 30 CEH per two-year period. LPCC: LPC requirement plus 10 additional clinical professional-development hours, related to intended practice and clinical in content. Three CE hours in ethics are required for all renewals. Keep records/documentation for audit.
data.passage: NDBCE: ‘An LPC (Licensed Professional Counselor) may renew his/her license every two years by documenting the completion of 30 continuing education hours (CEH) for the two-year period.’ ‘An LPCC (Licensed Professional Clinical Counselor) ... In addition to the 30 CEH’s required for renewal of the LPC, 10 additional hours of clinical professional development are required.’ ‘NOTE: all renewals require 3 continuing education hours in ethics.’ ‘Please keep all records and documentation for all Continuing Ed listed in the event of an audit.’ ‘Questions regarding the acceptance of continuing education experiences should be directed to the Board office.’ NDCC §43-47-06: the board renews upon demonstration of completion of CE requirements set by the board.

data.providerPathway: No fetched official North Dakota source established an LMFT board/provider approval pathway or that NBCC ACEP8109 approval qualifies for LMFT renewal CE. NBCC status is not equated with state approval.

data.providerPathway: NDBSWE requires ‘approved’ CE and provides an official pathway for an approved program/provider. EduCare ACEP8109’s NBCC provider status alone is not evidence of NDBSWE approval; acceptance is conditional on the specific course/provider meeting NDBSWE approval requirements.
data.asyncRule: Supported in principle: NDBSWE expressly includes ‘viewing a pre-recorded training with completion of posttest’ and home-study courses as independent learning. A completion certificate is not expressly stated in the fetched guideline, so retain the certificate and other records and verify course approval.
data.limits: 30 approved contact hours per two-year period; no more than 10 contact hours may be independent learning (including online studies without live interaction); at least 2 hours social-work ethics; excess cannot carry over. Academic conversion: 1 semester credit hour = 15 contact hours. Ethics may be face-to-face or self-study/distance learning.
data.passage: NDBSWE requirements: ‘thirty (30) approved continuing education contact hours’; ‘No more than ten (10) contact hours may be completed by independent learning which may include activities like online studies without live interaction’; ‘At least two (2) contact hours must concern social work ethics.’ Guidelines: ‘Independent learning hours include webinars in which there is no live, real-time interaction with the instructor, viewing a pre-recorded training with completion of posttest, and home study courses.’ ‘Academic coursework ... one semester credit hour is equal to 15 contact hours.’ The page links ‘Apply to become an Approved Provider (one-year approved status to offer any number of programs).’

data.providerPathway: Ohio Administrative Code 4757-9-05 recognizes programs offered by board-approved providers; NBCC ACEP8109 alone does not establish Ohio CSWMFT Board approved-provider status. Conditional on EduCare/the specific program being an Ohio-approved provider/program or otherwise eligible under the rule.

data.limits: 30 clock hours per renewal; 3 ethics hours; 60 minutes = 1 clock hour; approved-provider program minimum duration 1 clock hour. Certificates must state participant, hours, and ethics/distance/supervision hours where applicable.
data.passage: OAC 4757-9-01(B): ‘For licensed professional counselors and for licensed professional clinical counselors ... thirty clock hours of approved continuing professional education’; ‘For all renewals three of the thirty hours shall be taken in the area of ethics.’ OAC 4757-9-04(F): ‘Counselors, marriage and family therapists, and social workers may earn all hours ... per renewal period in distance learning credit.’ OAC 4757-9-04: ‘A “clock hour” is sixty minutes.’ OAC 4757-9-05(B)(2)(j): sponsor certificates must include participant name, number of clock hours, and hours of ethics/distance learning/supervision.

data.providerPathway: OAR 833-080-0041(2)(b) says an approvable program is designed/offered by an agency or institution recognized as an approved CEU provider, e.g. NBCC-approved programs; EduCare ACEP8109 would qualify only if it is in fact an NBCC Approved Continuing Education Provider (not merely NBCC-sponsored).
data.asyncRule: OAR 833-080-0041(1)(a)(C) expressly allows home study (distance learning), including internet and tele-courses. OAR 833-080-0041(2)(b)(E) requires a distance-learning mechanism for evaluation, measurement, or confirmation of exchange of information; a posttest can satisfy this pathway if it provides that mechanism. Certificate is required by OAR 833-080-0031(3).
data.limits: 40 clock hours per 24-month reporting period under OAR 833-080-0011(2)-(3); home study has no stated limit under 833-080-0041(1)(a) (listed among activities with no limits). 15 clock hours/semester credit and 10/quarter credit under 833-080-0041(1)(a)(A). Retain documentation at least two years after reporting period; dated completion certificates for home study under 833-080-0051(2)-(3)(b).

OAR 833-080-0041(2): "An approvable continuing education program is one designed and offered by an agency or institution that is recognized as an approved provider of continuing education units, e.g., NBCCapproved programs"; (E) "Distance learning program includes mechanism for evaluation, measurement, or confirmation of exchange of information." OAR 833-080-0051(3)(b): "For seminars, workshops, conferences, trainings, or home study: Dated certificates ... of completion of training."

OAR 833-080-0041(1)(a)(C): "Home study (distance learning), including internet and tele-courses"; (2) recognizes "NBCCapproved programs" and requires a distance-learning "mechanism for evaluation, measurement, or confirmation of exchange of information."

data.providerPathway: 49 Pa. Code §49.33(a) requires courses from Board-approved providers; the rule does not state that an NBCC Approved Continuing Education Provider (including EduCare ACEP8109) is Board-approved. A separate provider approval or §49.37 pathway would therefore need confirmation.

Code §49.33(d) expressly permits home study: the course must be offered by an approved provider, have specific learning objectives evaluated to assure learning, and be identified as home study on the certificate. This supports asynchronous home-study with a posttest/evaluation and completion certificate only if the provider is Board-approved.
data.limits: 30 clock hours per biennium; up to 20 may be home study; no carryover; at least 3 ethics and at least 2 child-abuse-recognition/reporting hours (§49.32). §49.35(a)(6) requires at least 1 clock hour and no partial credit. Retention/audit documentation is required by §49.38.

Home study courses must be indicated as such on the certificates of attendance."

data.limits: Current Board page states 40 hours in a 2-year cycle, including 4 ethics hours; supervisor licensees need 4 supervision hours. Other programs may be approved on request.
data.passage: ‘The board will accept qualified continuing education programs accredited, approved, or presented by ... National Board for Certified Counselors’; ‘The Board may approve other qualified continuing education programs upon request.’ The Board page states: ‘In a two-year cycle, 40 hours ... Four of those hours must be about ethics as it relates to counseling.’

data.providerPathway: The official LMFT rule defines qualified CE but does not identify NBCC or an NBCC-provider approval pathway.
data.asyncRule: No asynchronous/home-study or posttest provision was found in the fetched official LMFT rule; do not infer prohibition.
data.limits: ARSD 20:71:06:23 provides 15 CE hours per academic semester credit and 10 per quarter credit; no general renewal total appears in that rule.
data.passage: ‘Qualified continuing education is an academic course, workshop, clinic, forum, lecture, program, seminar, or other educational activity delivered for the purpose of increasing or sustaining the proficiency ... in ... marriage and family therapy’; ‘An academic semester credit equals 15 continuing education hours and a quarter credit equals ten continuing education hours.’

data.providerPathway: South Dakota social-work rules use an approved continuing-education sponsor; the official FAQ says programs approved by other state licensure boards, ASWB, and NASW are approved. NBCC/EduCare is not expressly named in the fetched social-work sources, so a separate sponsor approval is needed.
data.asyncRule: All contact hours may be obtained online. The distance-education rule allows approved-sponsor nonacademic training but limits independent/group study to 10 hours; it does not expressly require a posttest for asynchronous courses.
data.limits: 30 hours per 2-year period, including at least 6 social-work ethics hours; certificate of successful completion required. Independent/group study maximum 10 hours. One academic credit hour equals 15 contact hours; one CEU equals 10 contact hours.
data.passage: The FAQ says ‘All contact hours may now be obtained through online courses’ and that programs approved by ‘other state licensure boards ... ASWB and NASW’ are approved. ARSD 20:59:04:02 requires a ‘certificate of successful completion of thirty hours’ and six ethics hours. ARSD 20:59:04:01.01 says no more than ten hours may be independent/group study and defines one academic credit hour as 15 contact hours; ARSD 20:59:01:07 defines a CEU as 10 contact hours by an approved sponsor. (South Dakota’s clinical social-work credential is CSW-PIP rather than LCSW.)
